title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Agent 365 Business Analytics for AI spend, usage and value
summary: Hold: the briefing treats all reported spending as Copilot Credits governed in the Microsoft 365 admin center, but Microsoft documents separate GitHub AI credits, billing and budgets. Several control paths omit navigation steps, and the risk section overstates default access to cost insights.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans Business Analytics as one place bringing AI spend, usage and value together for investment decisions.
claims.quote: Agent 365 Business Analytics brings AI spend, usage, and value together in one place, helping leaders understand where AI investment is going, what value it’s delivering, and where to invest next.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes exploring cost across services, models, agents and users and understanding supported business use cases.
claims.quote: Explore cost across services, models, agents, and users, understand the business use cases AI supports and the value it creates

claims.claim: The roadmap describes forecasting future AI spend.
claims.quote: forecast future spend to make more informed investment decisions.

claims.claim: Business Analytics is a dedicated app for business decision makers and general managers to track Microsoft AI cost and usage.
claims.quote: Business Analytics is a dedicated app for business decision makers and general managers (GMs) to view and track the cost and usage of their organization's Microsoft AI services in one place.

claims.claim: The app includes Overview, Use cases, Cost & forecast, Users & groups and service-specific pages.
claims.quote:
Use cases | What do people use Microsoft AI services for?
Cost & forecast | How is AI cost tracking against budget, and where is it likely to land?
Users & groups | Who is using AI services, and how intensely?
Services pages (Microsoft Copilot, GitHub Copilot, and Agents)

claims.claim: The app brings licensed Microsoft 365 Copilot and usage-based services such as Cowork, agents and GitHub Copilot together.
claims.quote: brings insights for licensed Microsoft 365 Copilot and usage-based AI services, such as Copilot Cowork, agents, and GitHub Copilot, together in a single experience.

claims.claim: Cost & forecast focuses on usage-based billing and excludes Microsoft Copilot user subscription licence costs.
claims.quote: The Cost & forecast page focuses on usage-based billing. Microsoft Copilot user subscription license costs aren't included.

claims.claim: The Overview page shows Microsoft 365 Copilot cost as Included in license.
claims.quote: For Microsoft 365 Copilot, cost shows as "Included in license" because it's covered by the per-user license.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Cost & forecast offers base and growth forecasts, which are estimates.
claims.quote: Base or steady forecast, which assumes future usage is consistent with recent usage. Growth forecast, which allows recent usage growth to continue in the projection.

claims.claim: Forecast customization includes spend-cap and model-mix scenarios.
claims.quote:
Spend cap: Estimate the impact of applying a monthly spending cap
Model mix: Estimate the impact of shifting usage between models or providers

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Risk assessment; Governance controls; rationale: risk
claims.claim: A reporting budget target does not configure a spending policy or enforce a spending limit.
claims.quote: A reporting budget target helps you analyze spending. Creating the target doesn't configure a spending policy or enforce a spending limit.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; rationale: risk
claims.claim: A forecast scenario changes the comparison, not live access, model routing, policies, budgets or user limits.
claims.quote: A scenario changes only the forecast comparison. It doesn't modify live access, model routing, spending policies, budgets, or user limits.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Change & support
claims.claim: AI value estimates labour value rather than realised savings.
claims.quote: AI value is an estimate of the labor value associated with AI's contribution. It doesn't represent realized cost savings, increased revenue, or a guaranteed return on investment.

claims.claim: The cited AI value methodology documentation applies to Cowork.
claims.quote: This entire article applies to Cowork assisted hours and value, including customization. It does not apply to Copilot assisted hours and Copilot assisted value, including customization.

claims.claim: Leaders can inspect AI cost by user, group and model.
claims.quote:
Which services, models, groups, or job functions are driving changes in cost?
The Users tab shows people who have an assigned usage limit.
The table includes:
- User
- Services
- Cost

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure; Scope
claims.claim: The preview gives leaders in the top three organizational layers tenant-level app access by default.
claims.quote: Access by default | - Leaders in the top three layers of your organization, with tenant-level access

claims.claim: Managers whose teams meet the size threshold of 10 get preview insights for their own organization.
claims.quote: Managers of teams meeting the minimum group size of 10 can access insights for their own organization, including cost insights.

claims.claim: Microsoft 365 Global administrators have preview app access by default.
claims.quote: Microsoft 365 global admins have access by default.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure, first bullet
claims.claim: The automatic app access described for leaders, managers and Global administrators includes cost insights for all those people.
claims.quote: Cost, budget, and usage-based service insights appear only when consumption insights are turned on for your role. Consumption insights are on by default for GMs. For business leaders, an admin must turn them on.
claims.fix: Replace 'That includes cost insights for those people.' with 'Consumption insights are on by default for GMs; for business leaders, an admin must turn them on.' This also makes the risk bullet agree with Scope.

claims.claim: The Identification permission-set setting controls named versus de-identified data.
claims.quote: Identification | Whether users can view identifiable data, such as individual names, where your policies allow it. When identification is off, users see de-identified data instead.

claims.claim: The Cost & forecast Users tab lists people with assigned usage limits when the viewer's role permits access.
claims.quote: The Users tab under Spending limits appears when user limits are assigned and your role permits access.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Export is enabled by default through access management.
claims.quote: Export is only available when it's enabled for employees using access management. It's enabled by default.

claims.claim: CSV download is a documented export option.
claims.quote: CSV download: Create and download a file containing the selected service data

claims.claim: An MCP connection is among the documented export options.
claims.quote: MCP connection: View the setup information for making the service data available through an MCP connection

claims.claim: Including user identifiers in exports is off by default.
claims.quote: Because user identifiers are sensitive information, the setting is off by default.

claims.claim: Identifiable exports depend on the user's permission.
claims.quote: If you don't have permission to export identifiable information, the setting isn't displayed and the export uses anonymized identifiers.

claims.claim: Effective Business Analytics access combines valid assignments, and one assignment does not remove another's grants.
claims.quote: A capability that's turned on by any assignment is available to the user, and one assignment never removes access that another assignment grants.

claims.where: licensing.notes; Risk assessment: Change & support; Cost and licensing; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Spending policies are a prerequisite for usage-based service cost insights.
claims.quote: Spending policies for usage-based services must be set up for users to use these services and get cost insights.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Cost and licensing; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Administrators must turn on billing in the Microsoft 365 admin center for usage-based service and agent metrics to appear.
claims.quote: The admin must turn on billing in the Microsoft 365 admin center for users to see usage-based services and agents metrics.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support, calculator bullet
claims.claim: Calculator edits apply tenant-wide to dependent metrics and historical trends, moving every leader's numbers.

claims.claim: Administrators can customize the time assumptions used for Cowork assisted hours and value.
claims.quote: Time per use case | Estimated time a person would need to complete the use case without AI. Administrators can adjust this estimate to reflect their organization's workflows and expected effort.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Administrators can customize hourly labour rates used to estimate AI value.
claims.quote: Hourly rate | Estimated hourly labor cost used to calculate AI value. Administrators can adjust this value to reflect their organization's labor-cost assumptions.

claims.where: licensing.model; licensing.notes; summary; Cost and licensing; Open questions; rationale: cost
claims.claim: A separate licence or price for the Business Analytics app itself is not published; the licensing model is unknown.
claims.quote: Searched: "Agent 365 Business Analytics" "pricing" "license"; "Agent 365 Business Analytics" licensing price general availability default enabled. Opened introduction, admin introduction, configurations and Copilot Credits setup; found no separate app price or licence.

claims.where: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Governance guidance: Before rollout; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The introduction requires at least 50 assigned Copilot licences.
claims.quote: Tenant must have at least 50 Copilot licenses assigned.

claims.claim: The introduction lists access and partitions among the prerequisites.
claims.quote: Access. Admins can assign access and set up partitions for viewing Business Analytics and its various components using the access management page.

claims.claim: The app itself is not a meter.
claims.quote: Searched: "Agent 365 Business Analytics" "meter" billing; "Agent 365 Business Analytics" "pricing" "license". Opened introduction, Cost & forecast, Overview and Copilot Credits setup; none explicitly rules out metering use of the app itself.
claims.fix: Remove 'it is not a meter'. Retain the narrower statement that Microsoft has not published a separate app licence or price.

claims.where: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing, second paragraph
claims.claim: Usage-based AI cost reported by the app is billed as Copilot Credits to the selected subscription.
claims.quote: In the credits view, Microsoft AI credits and GitHub AI credits are shown separately.
claims.fix: Replace the licensing note's last sentence with 'The app reports both Microsoft and GitHub AI credits separately.' Replace the body's billing sentence with 'For Copilot Credits, charges go to the subscription selected in the billing method; the app reports GitHub AI credits separately.'

claims.claim: When Copilot Credits run out for the selected subscription, usage continues on a pay-as-you-go basis.
claims.quote: Copilot credits are billed to the subscription that you select in the billing method. New policies use it by default. When credits run out for that subscription, usage automatically continues on a pay-as-you-go basis.

claims.where: Why it matters; Cost and licensing; controls[2].governs; Governance controls
claims.claim: Spending policies in the Microsoft 365 admin center govern the usage-based spending reported by the app without a service exception.
claims.quote: Cost and credit information on this page is for reference only. For official billing and detailed charges for GitHub AI credits and budget setting, go to GitHub.com.
claims.fix: Narrow references to Microsoft 365 spending policies to 'Copilot Credits spending policies in the Microsoft 365 admin center'. Change controls[2].governs to 'Spending limits and billing for Copilot Credits reported by the app'. Do not imply this row controls GitHub spending.

claims.quote: The access controls described in this document aren't available in GCC-High or DoD. For GCC (Government Community Cloud), see the documentation for your specific app for availability.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not specified Business Analytics control behaviour in the government clouds listed on the roadmap.

No Business Analytics government-cloud control specification found.

claims.claim: The preview admin introduction says Insights analysts, Insights admins and other non-detected leaders or GMs need a Global administrator to assign access.

Access assigned by a Global admin | - Insights analysts

claims.quote: Consumption insights are on by default for GMs. For business leaders, an admin must turn them on.

claims.claim: Global, AI and Viva Insights administrators can manage Business Analytics access policies.

- AI administrator

claims.claim: Existing Viva Insights role assignments and organizational access scope carry over.
claims.quote: Users inherit the access and organizational scope of their existing roles from Viva Insights; role assignments don't need to be renewed.

claims.claim: Existing Viva Insights minimum-group-size settings carry over.
claims.quote: existing tenant-level settings such as minimum group size carry over from Viva Insights, which continue to hide aggregated insights for groups smaller than your configured thresholds.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; Why it matters; Open questions
claims.claim: The app's arrival and default state at general availability are not stated, distinct from documented preview access defaults.
claims.quote: Searched: "Agent 365 Business Analytics" "general availability" "automatically"; licensing price general availability default enabled. Read roadmap, introduction, admin introduction and access. These state preview defaults but no separate GA arrival/default commitment.

claims.claim: Business Analytics > Manage > Access management is the documented entry point for permission sets, partitions and access policies.

claims.claim: The Microsoft 365 admin center path starts at Viva > Settings > Manage feature access > Create a policy.
claims.quote:
From the Microsoft 365 admin center, select Viva from the settings menu.
Select the Settings tab and select Manage feature access.
Select Create a policy.
claims.fix: Replace the path in front matter and the rendered table with 'Settings > Viva > Settings > Manage feature access > Create a policy': the initial settings menu precedes Viva, while the later Settings is the tab within Viva.

claims.claim: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy with ModuleId VivaInsights, FeatureId 'Viva Insights web app', Name, IsFeatureEnabled $false and Everyone creates a tenant-wide disable policy.
claims.quote:
Example: Turn off the Viva Insights web app for all users in your tenant
ModuleId : VivaInsights
FeatureId : Viva Insights web app
Name : DisableFeatureForAll
IsFeatureEnabled : false
Everyone

In the Microsoft 365 admin center, go to Copilot and then the Cost Management node.
To unlock AI experiences enabled by usage-based billing, select Get Started.

claims.claim: GET /beta/copilot/costManagement/spendingPolicies is a Microsoft Graph beta operation for listing spending policies.

APIs under the /beta version are subject to change. Use of these APIs in production applications is not supported.

claims.claim: Creating spending policies requires a Global or Billing administrator.

claims.claim: The Cowork Value metrics path starts at Configurations > Metric calculators > Edit calculator > Value calculator > Value metrics.

To open the page in Business Analytics, on the left under Manage, select Configurations.
Under Cowork assisted hours and value, select Edit calculator.
claims.fix: Replace the path in front matter and the rendered table with 'Manage > Configurations > Metric calculators > Cowork assisted hours and value > Edit calculator > Value calculator > Value metrics'. claims.claim: Viva Insights administrators can configure Cowork value metrics, and Global administrators can configure Copilot value metrics.

claims.claim: The alternative to Global administrator for configuring Copilot value metrics is holding both Viva Insights administrator and Chief officer roles.
claims.quote: Only users who have both Viva Insights admins and Chief officer roles, or who are global admins, can configure Copilot value metrics.

claims.claim: The Cowork Value metrics display toggle applies tenant-wide and is off by default.
claims.quote: Administrators can control whether AI value metrics for Cowork are displayed to users in their organization. This setting applies across the tenant and is turned off by default.

claims.claim: The privacy threshold path starts at Configurations > Privacy > Minimum group size.

claims.fix: Replace the path in front matter and the rendered table with 'Manage > Configurations > Privacy > Minimum group size'.

claims.claim: No PowerShell or API for Business Analytics privacy settings is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: "Agent 365 Business Analytics" calculator privacy minimum group size PowerShell API; "Business Analytics" "minimum group size" "Set-". Opened manage/configurations, Viva privacy-settings and manage-settings-copilot-dashboard; no privacy-setting automation found.
